verdict.rationale: Resend documents 'recurring flows with automations' for marketing broadcasts, scheduled sends ('in 1 min' or ISO dates), and webhooks for event-driven notifications, all of which can operate without manual intervention once configured. However, these are email-marketing automation features, not general-purpose autonomous background agents, and there's no evidence of AI-driven decision logic or agent orchestration beyond passive triggers/schedules. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-agent-controlled autonomous workflows (not just scheduled/triggered email sends), independent hands-on confirmation of the automations feature actually running unattended.
